layout.arrangement: A thin red rectangular frame outlines the entire slide. Title 'Neural Network Model' is centered at the top in bold dark red; a yellow circle badge with '29' sits in the top-right corner. On the row just below the title, a magenta 'Input Sample' box is at the far left and a magenta 'Target Label' box is at the upper right, joined by a horizontal dashed magenta arrow pointing right. The middle-left is dominated by a large beige rectangular panel containing a 3-layer feed-forward neural-network diagram (input dots → summation/activation nodes → weighted links → output nodes → Output 1/2/m boxes). Immediately right of that panel is a tall dark-red vertical bar with rotated white text 'Error Error Error', and to its right a vertical stack of three pale-green 'Class 1 / Class 2 / Class m' boxes. The upper-right quadrant holds a beige legend box with red border (Net_j / O_j / w_ji definitions) and, below it, a white box with red border giving the I/P and O/P node counts. Beneath the network panel are two up-arrow callouts: a blue-outlined arrow with a light-blue 'Previous Layer / Layer (i)' box under the middle node column, and a green-outlined arrow with a light-green 'Current Layer / (You are here)' box under the right node column. The bottom strip contains, from left to right: a white header box 'For Layer “j”' above a pale-yellow formula box (Net_j = ∑ (w_ji O_i)); a centered pale-yellow formula box (O_j = f(Net_j) = 1/(1+e^{-Net_j})); and, at the right, a white header box 'If Layer “j” is Output Layer:' above a pale-yellow error formula box (E = 1/2 ∑ (t_j - O_j)^2).
